name: Estonia

authorities.competent_authority: State Agency of Medicines (Ravimiamet): performs the Member State functions under the CTR, assesses the application with experts and the Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products, and issues the national decision.
authorities.ethics: One Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products for all medicinal-product trials (no choice between local committees). It prepares the Part II ethical assessment; the Agency takes its conclusion into account.
authorities.fee: No prepayment of the specialised assessment fee. The sponsor provides invoice-recipient and decision-recipient details; Ravimiamet invoices within 10 days after the application is accepted for evaluation. Statutory exemptions for certain academic sponsors and orphan-medicinal-product trials (EE-FEE). The guides state no amount.
authorities.national_guidance: Estonia Medicinal Products Act (sections 99³ and 99⁵); Ravimiamet, Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products: Part II requirements, compensation and consent Q&A (updated 25 May 2026); Ravimiamet, Clinical Trials Regulation no 536/2014 page (updated 30 June 2026), including the CTIS instruction on Estonian patient-facing materials from 27 April 2026; Ravimiamet clinical-trial forms page with the Estonia SIS/ICF templates (Estonian and English); Ravimiamet clinical trials in Estonia page (Health Information System and monitoring); EudraLex Volume 10 including the July 2026 Q&A and Part II templates; ICH E6(R3) published by Ravimiamet as current GCP guidance.

answer_languages_note: One package language, Estonian, for every participant-facing document and, by default, for the shared forms (matching the supplied Estonian variable sheet). The guides say the application dossier is generally in English: M1 must be in English, M2 follows it, and English is an allowed alternative for N1, P1, R1 and S1 (DECISIONS.md D1). Other participant languages intended for use (for example Russian or English) are extra versions of the participant documents, not separate packages (DECISIONS.md D2).

language_rules.rule: The application dossier is generally submitted in English. Information specified in Part L of Annex I to the CTR and other information aimed at participants must be in Estonian (Medicinal Products Act; the Commission language table lists Estonian for translated patient-facing documents).
language_rules.other_participant_languages: All materials provided to participants must be supplied in all languages in which they are intended to be used (Ravimiamet). Study fact population.non_estonian_speakers decides which extra versions (_EE_<lang>) each participant document needs. The guides do not mention Russian: a Russian version is required only when Russian will be used with participants (DECISIONS.md D2).
language_rules.english_versions: The English master is not the participant document in Estonia unless English will genuinely be used with a specific participant group. For multinational trials the English patient-facing versions stay in Part I under the EU Q&A, and the Estonian versions go in Part II section R from 27 April 2026 (EE-R2; DECISIONS.md D3).

mandatory_english.EE-M1: The Principal Investigator CV must be in English.

language_rules.form_answers: Shared EU forms (content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Estonian by default; English allowed for N1, P1, R1 and S1 (DECISIONS.md D1).

study_facts_country_specific.population.non_estonian_speakers: Will participant materials be used in a language other than Estonian (for example Russian or English), and which? Each such language needs a complete version of every participant document used (DECISIONS.md D2).
study_facts_country_specific.trial.multinational: Is the trial conducted in more than one Member State? Decides the CTIS placement of Estonian patient-facing materials (EE-R2: Part II section R from 27 April 2026; mononational trials follow the EU Q&A).
study_facts_country_specific.consent.remote: Is remote consent planned? Needs a video call with electronic identification, a legally accepted signature, and justification and approval by the Ethics Committee before implementation (K1 v108).
study_facts_country_specific.compensation.time_or_burden_offered: Is compensation for time, inconvenience or burdensome procedures offered to competent participants? Needs justification in the application and Ethics Committee approval (P1).
study_facts_country_specific.insurance.academic_exemption_confirmed: Is the trial an academic study whose participants are covered by the national health insurance system, with eligibility for the insurance exception confirmed under the Medicinal Products Act and Health Insurance Act? If not, O1 is required.
study_facts_country_specific.fee.exemption_claimed: Does the sponsor claim a statutory fee exemption (academic sponsor or orphan-medicinal-product trial)? Confirm the current Medicinal Products Act conditions (EE-FEE).

documents.ctis_title_note: _EE_en if the form is answered in English (DECISIONS.md D1).
documents.language_rule: Answered in Estonian by default (supplied Estonian variable sheet; the form describes the consent procedure for Estonian participant information). The guides say the application dossier is generally in English and give no separate rule for this form, so English is an option (DECISIONS.md D1).

languages_required.en: Allowed alternative under the general dossier rule (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: European Commission Informed Consent and Patient Recruitment Procedure template, version 2.0 (highly recommended for new Part II submissions; transition period ended 1 September 2026). The Estonia checklist says to use this template.

documents.content: How participants are identified and recruited, who approaches them, how they are informed, given time and consented; the recruitment materials used and the process around them. Member State fields completed for Estonia. Every population pathway in the plan (minors with the 7 to 17 co-consent rule, incapacitated adults, impartial witness, emergency) has its section completed; remote consent described if planned.

national_fields.v105: Required in Estonia: in the answer language, state that every recruitment material used in Estonia (advertisement, letter, poster, digital content) is submitted under Recruitment arrangements as an approved draft in Estonian, and in every other language in which it will be used, before use; that each item carries the EU CT number; that recruitment material contains no compensation information, which belongs in the informed consent form; and that recruitment material is not signed by prospective participants.
national_fields.v108: Required in Estonia: in the answer language, state that information for participants is given in Estonian, and in every other language in which it is intended to be used; that before consent the participant or legal representative speaks with a trial-team member who is a doctor, nurse or pharmacist, has thorough knowledge of the trial and the investigational medicinal product and can give a complete explanation (Medicinal Products Act); that the participant has adequate time to consider participation; that consent is written, dated and signed by the participant or legal representative and by the person conducting the consent interview, and that a digital signature valid under Estonian law is permitted; that the participant or representative receives a copy; that the information form allows separate consents for trial participation and for use of pseudonymised health data or biological samples, without presenting trial consent as the GDPR legal basis; and, if remote consent is planned, that it uses a video call and electronic identification, allows clear identification of the people involved, normal questioning and discussion, time to decide and the same rights as a face-to-face discussion, keeps a legally accepted signature, and is justified and approved by the Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products before implementation.
national_fields.v110: Required in Estonia when incapacitated adults are included: in the answer language, state that the legal representative gives informed consent taking the participant's presumed intent into account and that a representative's decision cannot be relied on where it clearly harms the participant's interests (Medicinal Products Act); that the participant is informed to a reasonable extent, with information adapted to the capacity to understand; that a diagnosis, disability or age alone is not treated as proof of incapacity; that an explicit wish of a participant capable of forming an opinion to refuse or withdraw is respected; how the site identifies regained capacity and obtains and documents the participant's own consent; and that participants and representatives receive no compensation for participation beyond reimbursement of direct costs.
national_fields.v114: Required in Estonia when minors are included: in the answer language, state that for participants aged 7 to 17 consent is obtained from the minor as well as from the legal representative, taking the minor's intent into account (Medicinal Products Act), and that the documents make each person's decision and signature clear; that below 7 the legal representative gives consent and the child is involved in a way appropriate to age and understanding; how the legal representative's authority and the number of representative signatures are verified for the case (no two-parent rule assumed without a verified legal basis); that an explicit wish of a minor capable of forming an opinion to refuse or withdraw is respected; how re-consent with the adult form is obtained and documented when the participant reaches adulthood during the trial; and that minors and their representatives receive no compensation for participation beyond reimbursement of direct costs.
national_fields.v117: Required in Estonia when an impartial witness may be needed: in the answer language, state when a witness is used (the participant or legal representative cannot write, Article 29; and the ICH E6(R3) case of a person unable to read); that the witness is independent of the trial and protected from undue influence and is not a substitute legal representative; how the witness is selected; that the consent discussion with a doctor, nurse or pharmacist of the trial team, adequate decision time and the right to ask questions are preserved; how information read aloud or given by another method is documented; that the witness signs and dates the consent document, the participant or representative signs where able and the person conducting the interview signs and dates; and that the participant or representative receives a copy.
national_fields.v121: Required in Estonia when emergency enrolment is used: in the answer language, explain each Article 35 condition for the specific emergency condition and therapeutic window; the procedure for identifying and documenting the emergency, the reason prior consent is impossible, the check for an available legal representative within the therapeutic window and for known prior objections, and the protective measures before consent; that consent to continue is sought without undue delay from the legal representative (minors and incapacitated participants) or from the participant or legal representative, whichever is available first; that a later refusal or withdrawal is respected and what happens to treatment, follow-up and data already collected; and what is documented (time of intervention, why prior consent was impossible, when the participant or representative was informed, when the ongoing-consent decision was recorded). Estonia publishes no separate national emergency form.

documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis K (Recruitment arrangements). Kohustuslik dokument. Vastused vaikimisi eesti keeles; üldine taotlustoimik on üldjuhul inglise keeles, seega on inglise keel võimalik (DECISIONS.md D1). Esitamisel allkirjata. Alus: Euroopa Komisjoni teadliku nõusoleku ja värbamise korra vorm, versioon 2.0 (uute II osa esitamiste puhul tungivalt soovitatav; üleminekuaeg lõppes 1. septembril 2026). Täitke Eesti liikmesriigi väljad (national_fields): EL-i uuringu number kõigil värbamismaterjalidel; hüvitise teave kuulub nõusolekuvormi, mitte värbamisreklaami; enne nõusolekut vestleb uuritav või seaduslik esindaja uuringumeeskonna arsti, õe või proviisoriga, kes tunneb uuringut ja uuritavat ravimit põhjalikult (ravimiseadus); Eesti õiguse kohaselt kehtiv digiallkiri on lubatud; kaugnõusolek ainult videokõne ja elektroonilise isikutuvastusega ning eetikakomitee eelneval heakskiidul. Iga populatsiooni (7–17-aastased alaealised koos seadusliku esindajaga, teovõimetud täiskasvanud, erapooletu tunnistaja, erakorraline kaasamine) jaoks täitke vastav jaotis; muidu märkige, et see ei kohaldu.

documents.ctis_title_note: One title per item and language; _EE_<lang> for each other language in which the item will be used (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.name_en: Recruitment materials (advertisements, letters, posters, digital content)
documents.trigger_text: Recruitment materials such as advertisements, letters, posters or digital content will be used in Estonia.
documents.language_rule: Estonian; every other language in which the material is intended to be used is provided as well (study fact population.non_estonian_speakers).

languages_required.other: Each other language in which the item will be used, for example Russian or English (DECISIONS.md D2).

documents.signature_rule: Submitted as approved draft materials; not signed by prospective participants.
documents.content: Final wording of each recruitment item. Carries the EU CT number. No compensation information (it belongs in the informed consent form). Claims checked against the protocol and the consent package.
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis K. Tingimuslik: iga Eestis kasutatav värbamismaterjal (reklaam, kiri, plakat, digitaalne sisu), üks dokument materjali ja keele kohta. Eesti keeles ning igas muus keeles, milles materjali kavatsetakse kasutada. Igal materjalil peab olema EL-i uuringu number. Hüvitise teavet värbamismaterjali ei lisata; see kuulub teadliku nõusoleku vormi. Esitatakse heakskiidetud mustandina, uuritavad seda ei allkirjasta. Väited peavad vastama protokollile ja nõusolekudokumentidele. Mallita: koostage protokolli ja värbamiskorra (K1) põhjal.

documents.ctis_title_note: _EE_<lang> for each other participant language intended for use (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.name_en: Subject information and informed consent form, one set per population and decision-maker
documents.language_rule: Information aimed at participants must be in Estonian (Medicinal Products Act; Commission language table). All materials given to participants are supplied in every language in which they are intended to be used. The English master is not the participant document unless English will genuinely be used with a participant group.

languages_required.other: Each other language in which the document will be used with participants, for example Russian or English (study fact population.non_estonian_speakers; DECISIONS.md D2).

documents.template_status: missing: no Estonian participant templates supplied, and the Estonia national Subject Information and Informed Consent Form template (Ravimiamet, approved by the Ethics Committee, Estonian and English versions) recommended as the drafting baseline was not supplied; see population_sets (every template "missing") and DECISIONS.md D15.
documents.signature_rule: Blank at submission. When consent is obtained: written, dated and signed by the participant or legal representative and by the person conducting the consent interview (Article 29); a digital signature valid under Estonian law is permitted.
documents.content: Blank Estonian information and consent document for each population that can enter the trial, adapted from the national template or the EC templates to the actual intervention, procedures, population, risks, data flows, samples, reimbursement and optional research. Separate or adapted documents when a population or procedure cannot be covered safely by the default adult form (item 10 of the checklist). See population_sets.
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis L (Subject information and informed consent form). Kohustuslik dokument, esitamisel allkirjata; nõusoleku andmisel allkirjastavad ja dateerivad uuritav või seaduslik esindaja ja nõusolekuvestluse läbiviija (lubatud on Eesti õiguse kohaselt kehtiv digiallkiri). Eesti keeles ning igas muus keeles, milles dokumenti kavatsetakse uuritavatega kasutada. EL-i uuringu number igal dokumendil; kasutage sõna „uuringus osaleja“ (ingl. participant), mitte „patsient“. Riiklik alus: Ravimiameti uuritava teabe ja teadliku nõusoleku vormi mall (soovituslik; ei ole esitatud) või Euroopa Komisjoni II osa mallid. Andmekaitse selgitatakse üksikasjalikult; eraldi nõusolekud uuringus osalemiseks ning pseudonüümitud terviseandmete või bioloogiliste proovide kasutamiseks. Kulude hüvitamise ja võimaliku hüvitise põhimõtted kirjeldatakse selles vormis. Iga populatsiooni jaoks eraldi või kohandatud dokument (population_sets).

documents.ctis_title_note: Multinational trials only. Mononational trial: follow the EU Q&A route (Part I, D4_Patient-facing document_<type>_<lang>) and confirm the CTIS structure before filing (DECISIONS.md D3).
documents.name_en: Estonian-language patient-facing materials (questionnaires, diaries, cards and similar items whose English version is in Part I)
documents.trigger_text: From 27 April 2026 Ravimiamet instructs sponsors of multinational trials to submit Estonian-language patient-facing materials in Section R of Part II instead of Section D of Part I; the English versions stay in Part I under the EU Q&A. Mononational trials are excepted.
documents.language_rule: Estonian translation of the English Part I version; other participant languages only if they will be used (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.content: Estonian version of each patient-facing item, matched by name, version and language to its English Part I counterpart so assessors can pair them. Carries the EU CT number.
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis R. Tingimuslik: alates 27. aprillist 2026 esitatakse rahvusvaheliste uuringute eestikeelsed uuritavale suunatud materjalid (küsimustikud, päevikud, kaardid jms) II osa jaotises R, mitte I osa jaotises D; ingliskeelsed versioonid jäävad EL-i küsimuste ja vastuste kohaselt I ossa. Ainult ühes liikmesriigis toimuva uuringu puhul järgige EL-i küsimuste ja vastuste reegleid ning kontrollige CTIS-i struktuuri enne esitamist. Nimi, versioon ja keel peavad võimaldama siduda dokumendi selle ingliskeelse vastega. EL-i uuringu number igal materjalil. Esitamisel allkirjata.

template.basis: European Commission Investigator Curriculum Vitae template (accepted in Estonia)

documents.signature_rule: Dated and signed by the Principal Investigator; no more than six months old at submission. The template has no signature line: the investigator adds signature and date.
documents.content: English CV of the Principal Investigator at each Estonian site, with the most recent Good Clinical Practice training and the year the certificate was issued. The GCP certificate itself is not submitted when this information is in the CV. Personal details come from the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis M (Suitability of the investigator). Kohustuslik iga uuringukeskuse vastutava uurija (Principal Investigator) kohta. Inglise keeles, vastutava uurija poolt dateeritud ja allkirjastatud, esitamisel mitte vanem kui kuus kuud. Peab sisaldama viimast hea kliinilise tava (GCP) koolitust ja tunnistuse väljastamise aastat; tunnistust ennast ei esitata, kui see teave on elulookirjelduses. Euroopa Komisjoni elulookirjelduse mall on aktsepteeritud. Assistent täidab ainult uuringu pealkirja ja EL-i uuringu numbri; ülejäänu täidab uurija, isikuandmeid ei mõelda välja. Märkus: Ravimiameti järgi peavad kõik aktiivselt osalevad meeskonnaliikmed olema 2026. aasta septembriks ICH E6(R3) koolituse läbinud (riskipõhine koolituskäsitlus); seda ei esitata eraldi dokumendina.

documents.language_rule: The guides state no language for this item; English under the general dossier rule, matching the CV.

template.basis: European Commission Declaration of Interest template (accepted in Estonia)

documents.signature_rule: The Estonia guides state no signature rule for the declaration (the CV must be signed); the template's date field is completed by the investigator (DECISIONS.md D13).
documents.content: The Principal Investigator's financial and other interests, stated by the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis M. Kohustuslik iga uuringukeskuse vastutava uurija huvide deklaratsioon. Euroopa Komisjoni huvide deklaratsiooni mall on aktsepteeritud. Keel juhendites määramata; üldise reegli järgi inglise keeles nagu elulookirjeldus. Allkirjanõuet juhendites ei ole (DECISIONS.md D13). Assistent täidab ainult uuringu pealkirja ja EL-i uuringu numbri; huvid deklareerib uurija ise.

documents.language_rule: Answered in Estonian by default; English allowed under the general dossier rule (DECISIONS.md D1). The study centre is named by its legal name, optionally with a commonly used English name in parentheses.

template.basis: European Commission Site Suitability Form (the Estonia checklist says to submit it for each site)

documents.signature_rule: Signed by a person legally authorised by the study centre; manual signature on paper or digital signature accepted. CTIS does not accept the Estonian .asice container: upload a PDF and retain the original .asice at the study centre.
documents.content: One form per Estonian site under the site's legal name: suitability statement, facilities, equipment, trial procedures at the site and human resources. Site facts and the signature come from the site.

national_fields.v125: Required in Estonia: identify the study centre by its legal name; a commonly used English name may be added in parentheses. Site facts come from the site.
national_fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Estonia: the form is signed by a person legally authorised by the study centre (manual signature on paper or digital signature). The site completes and signs; the assistant leaves the block empty. If the original is an Estonian .asice digital-signature container, upload a PDF in CTIS and retain the .asice original at the study centre.

documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields and signature left empty for the site
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis N (Suitability of the facilities). Kohustuslik, iga Eesti uuringukeskuse kohta üks Euroopa Komisjoni vorm. Kasutage uuringukeskuse juriidilist nime; sulgudes võib lisada üldkasutatava ingliskeelse nime. Vormi allkirjastab uuringukeskuse seaduslikult volitatud isik; lubatud on omakäeline või digiallkiri. CTIS ei aktsepteeri .asice-konteinerit: laadige üles PDF ja säilitage algne .asice-fail uuringukeskuses. Keskuse andmed ja allkiri tulevad keskuselt; assistent jätab need tühjaks ega mõtle midagi välja.

documents.name_en: Proof of insurance cover or indemnification
documents.unless_text: Ravimiamet states that additional private insurance is not required for certain academic studies when participants are covered by the national health insurance system and the statutory conditions are met. Apply only after confirming eligibility under the Medicinal Products Act and the Health Insurance Act (DECISIONS.md D16).
documents.language_rule: The guides state no language for the certificate; as issued by the insurer, under the general dossier rule.
documents.signature_rule: Insurer-issued certificate submitted as evidence; no sponsor signature stated.
documents.content: Certificate stating the trial identifier (EU CT number, or the protocol number together with the trial title), Estonia as the country, the insurance period and the insured amount. The guides state no minimum amount.
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis O (Proof of insurance cover or indemnification). Tavapärases kommertsuuringus kohustuslik. Kindlustussertifikaadil peavad olema uuringu tunnus (EL-i uuringu number või protokolli number koos uuringu pealkirjaga), riigina Eesti, kindlustusperiood ja kindlustussumma. Akadeemilise uuringu erand (täiendavat erakindlustust ei nõuta, kui uuritav on kaetud riikliku ravikindlustusega ja seadusest tulenevad tingimused on täidetud) kohaldub ainult pärast tingimuste kontrollimist ravimiseaduse ja ravikindlustuse seaduse alusel. Sertifikaadi väljastab kindlustusandja; nõusolekudokumentide kindlustusteave peab sellega kokku langema.

documents.language_rule: Answered in Estonian by default; English allowed under the general dossier rule (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: European Commission Compensation for Trial Participants template (the Estonia checklist says to use it)

documents.signature_rule: The Estonia guides state no signature requirement.
documents.content: Reimbursement of unavoidable direct trial-related expenses (always) and any compensation for inconvenience and burdensome procedures for competent participants, with justification. Restrictions for minors, incapacitated participants, their representatives, pregnant women and breastfeeding women. Amounts and conditions identical to the participant documents.

national_fields.f04: Estonia: monetary compensation is allowed only for competent participants, for inconvenience and burdensome procedures, when the need and amount are justified in the application and approved by the Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products; it reflects time and contribution (for healthy volunteers the time element is based on the minimum wage in force in Estonia in the year the trial was initiated), is not payment for risk and does not depend on the risk level. Minors and their representatives, incapacitated participants and their representatives, pregnant women and breastfeeding women receive only reimbursement of direct costs.
national_fields.f06: Estonia: no completion bonus, no payment made conditional on completing the trial and no large share held back to encourage continued participation. Amounts and conditions only from the sponsor's sources.

documents.filled_by: assistant; amounts and conditions only from the sponsor's sources
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis P (Financial and other arrangements). Kohustuslik; kasutage Euroopa Komisjoni uuritavate hüvitamise malli. Uuringus osalemisest otseselt tulenevad vältimatud kulud hüvitatakse alati ja põhjendatakse taotluses. Teovõimelisele uuritavale võib maksta põhjendatud hüvitist ebamugavuste ja koormavate protseduuride eest, kui vajadus ja summa on taotluses põhjendatud ning eetikakomitee on selle heaks kiitnud; summa peegeldab aega ja panust (tervete vabatahtlike puhul arvestatakse aega uuringu alustamise aastal kehtiva Eesti alampalga alusel), see ei ole tasu riski eest ega sõltu riski suurusest. Alaealistele ja nende esindajatele, teovõimetutele ja nende esindajatele, rasedatele ja rinnaga toitvatele naistele hüvitatakse ainult otsesed kulud. Lõpetamisboonust ei maksta, täismakset ei seota uuringu lõpetamisega ega hoita suurt osa tagasi. Summad ja tingimused ainult sponsori allikatest ning samad mis nõusolekudokumentides.

documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide has only the P1 example; P2 is proposed for the trial-budget information (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.name_en: Trial budget information and Health Insurance Fund statement
documents.language_rule: The guides state no language; English under the general dossier rule, or Estonian (DECISIONS.md D1).
documents.signature_rule: The Estonia guides state no signature requirement.
documents.content: Transparent information on the trial budget; the per-participant fee may be used as the basis if its breakdown is explained. Confirmation that trial-specific services will not be billed to the Estonian Health Insurance Fund.
documents.kind_note: Becomes a drafted document if the sponsor wants TrialAgents to write it from the sponsor's figures (DECISIONS.md D6).
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis P. Kohustuslik läbipaistev teave uuringu eelarve kohta; aluseks võib võtta uuritava kohta makstava tasu, kui selle jaotus on selgitatud. Kinnitage, et uuringuspetsiifilisi teenuseid ei esitata tasumiseks Eesti Haigekassale. Pealkiri P2 on ettepanek (DECISIONS.md D6). Summad ainult sponsorilt; ei mõelda välja.

documents.ctis_section: Forms (fee and invoice information; CTIS location to confirm)
documents.ctis_title_note: Estonia requires no prepayment, so there is no payment proof; the naming guide gives no title for the Forms section. Proposed title if a file is needed (DECISIONS.md D5).
documents.language_rule: Not stated in the guides; administrative information.
documents.content: Invoice recipient's details, including postal address and one organisation email address based on the CTIS LOC code, plus the email address for the decision recipient. No prepayment of the specialised assessment fee: Ravimiamet issues the invoice within 10 days after the application is accepted for evaluation. Conditional: a statutory fee exemption for academic sponsors (licensed healthcare provider, independent research institution or physicians' specialty organisation, with an application confirming no financial or other compensation from a medicine manufacturer or its representative apart from trial medicines) or certain orphan-medicinal-product trials, only after confirming the current Medicinal Products Act conditions (study fact fee.exemption_claimed).
documents.drafting_notes_et: Haldusteave (CTIS-i vormide osa; täpne asukoht kinnitada, DECISIONS.md D5). Kohustuslik: arve saaja andmed, sh postiaadress ja üks CTIS-i LOC-koodil põhinev organisatsiooni e-posti aadress, ning otsuse saaja e-posti aadress. Eesti ei nõua menetlustasu ettemaksu; Ravimiamet esitab arve 10 päeva jooksul pärast taotluse menetlusse võtmist. Tingimuslik tasust vabastus akadeemilisele sponsorile (tegevusloaga tervishoiuteenuse osutaja, sõltumatu teadusasutus või arstide erialaselts koos avaldusega, et ta ei saa ravimitootjalt ega selle esindajalt rahalist ega muud tasu peale uuringuravimite) või teatud harvikravimi uuringutele, ainult pärast kehtivate ravimiseaduse tingimuste kontrollimist.

documents.ctis_section: Form (GDPR statement in the CTIS Form section)
documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_EE
documents.ctis_title_note: The Estonia checklist places the EU statement in the CTIS Form section; the naming guide says the Form-section GDPR statement uses another upload location and gives no other title, so the CTCG R1 title is kept as the document title (DECISIONS.md D4).
documents.language_rule: Answered in Estonian by default; English allowed under the general dossier rule (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: EU statement on compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679; Estonia adds no national statement

documents.signature_rule: The Estonia guides state no signature requirement; name, role and date of the responsible person at the sponsor come from the sponsor.
documents.content: EU GDPR statement in the CTIS Form section. No national sentence. Estonia also requires the data-protection aspects to be explained in detail in the participant information (EE-L1), consistent with this statement.

national_fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Not applicable in Estonia: the guides require no national data-protection statement in the EU statement; remove the conditional field. Detailed data-protection information goes into the participant information (EE-L1).

documents.filled_by: assistant; name and role of the responsible person at the sponsor from the sponsor
documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS-i vormide osa (Form section), mitte eraldi II osa narratiiv. Kohustuslik EL-i kinnitus isikuandmete kaitse üldmääruse (EL) 2016/679 järgimise kohta. Eesti ei nõua riiklikku lisalauset: tingimuslik väli r1_the_sponsor_declares ei kohaldu ja eemaldatakse. Andmekaitse tuleb lisaks üksikasjalikult selgitada uuritava teabes ja nõusolekuvormis (EE-L1) ning see peab kinnitusega kokku langema. Sponsori vastutava isiku nimi ja ametikoht tulevad sponsorilt; ei mõelda välja.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_EE
documents.name_en: Compliance with applicable rules for biological samples
documents.trigger_text: Biological samples are collected, stored, transported or retained.
documents.language_rule: Answered in Estonian by default; English allowed under the general dossier rule (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: European Commission Compliance with Applicable Rules for Biological Samples form

documents.signature_rule: The Estonia guides state no signature requirement.
documents.content: For every sample type: what is collected, pseudonymised or anonymised, transport, storage location, storage duration in years and time of destruction; whether samples may leave Estonia or the EEA; optional future use kept separate from the main trial.

national_fields.f03: Required in Estonia: describe for each sample type what is collected, whether it is pseudonymised or anonymised, how it is transported, where it is stored, how long it is stored in years and when it will be destroyed; state whether samples may leave Estonia or the EEA and whether genetic analysis is involved.

documents.drafting_notes_et: CTIS II osa, jaotis S. Tingimuslik: kui bioloogilisi proove kogutakse, säilitatakse, transporditakse või hoitakse alles. Kirjeldage iga proovitüübi puhul, mida kogutakse, kas materjal on pseudonüümitud või anonüümitud, kuidas seda transporditakse, kus seda säilitatakse, kui kaua (aastates) ja millal see hävitatakse; kas proovid võivad lahkuda Eestist või EMP-st ja kas tehakse geneetilist analüüsi. Võimalik tulevane kasutus hoitakse põhiuuringust eraldi. Andmed peavad vastama protokollile, laborijuhendile ja nõusolekudokumentidele.

checklist_mapping_note: 13 document entries for the 10 items of the Estonia Part II document checklist page (checklist_item on each entry). Item 1 is split into K1 (procedure) and K2 (recruitment materials); item 2 into L1 (SIS/ICF per population) and R2 (Estonian patient-facing materials in section R under Ravimiamet's 27 April 2026 instruction); item 3 into M1 (CV) and M2 (declaration of interests); item 6 into P1 (EU compensation form) and P2 (trial budget and Health Insurance Fund statement), which the P1 form has no field for. Item 10 (population-specific consent documents) is covered by EE-L1 and population_sets.

fields.v105: Required in Estonia: in the answer language, state that every recruitment material used in Estonia (advertisement, letter, poster, digital content) is submitted under Recruitment arrangements as an approved draft in Estonian, and in every other language in which it will be used, before use; that each item carries the EU CT number; that recruitment material contains no compensation information, which belongs in the informed consent form; and that recruitment material is not signed by prospective participants.
fields.v108: Required in Estonia: in the answer language, state that information for participants is given in Estonian, and in every other language in which it is intended to be used; that before consent the participant or legal representative speaks with a trial-team member who is a doctor, nurse or pharmacist, has thorough knowledge of the trial and the investigational medicinal product and can give a complete explanation (Medicinal Products Act); that the participant has adequate time to consider participation; that consent is written, dated and signed by the participant or legal representative and by the person conducting the consent interview, and that a digital signature valid under Estonian law is permitted; that the participant or representative receives a copy; that the information form allows separate consents for trial participation and for use of pseudonymised health data or biological samples, without presenting trial consent as the GDPR legal basis; and, if remote consent is planned, that it uses a video call and electronic identification, allows clear identification of the people involved, normal questioning and discussion, time to decide and the same rights as a face-to-face discussion, keeps a legally accepted signature, and is justified and approved by the Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products before implementation.
fields.v110: Required in Estonia when incapacitated adults are included: in the answer language, state that the legal representative gives informed consent taking the participant's presumed intent into account and that a representative's decision cannot be relied on where it clearly harms the participant's interests (Medicinal Products Act); that the participant is informed to a reasonable extent, with information adapted to the capacity to understand; that a diagnosis, disability or age alone is not treated as proof of incapacity; that an explicit wish of a participant capable of forming an opinion to refuse or withdraw is respected; how the site identifies regained capacity and obtains and documents the participant's own consent; and that participants and representatives receive no compensation for participation beyond reimbursement of direct costs.
fields.v114: Required in Estonia when minors are included: in the answer language, state that for participants aged 7 to 17 consent is obtained from the minor as well as from the legal representative, taking the minor's intent into account (Medicinal Products Act), and that the documents make each person's decision and signature clear; that below 7 the legal representative gives consent and the child is involved in a way appropriate to age and understanding; how the legal representative's authority and the number of representative signatures are verified for the case (no two-parent rule assumed without a verified legal basis); that an explicit wish of a minor capable of forming an opinion to refuse or withdraw is respected; how re-consent with the adult form is obtained and documented when the participant reaches adulthood during the trial; and that minors and their representatives receive no compensation for participation beyond reimbursement of direct costs.
fields.v117: Required in Estonia when an impartial witness may be needed: in the answer language, state when a witness is used (the participant or legal representative cannot write, Article 29; and the ICH E6(R3) case of a person unable to read); that the witness is independent of the trial and protected from undue influence and is not a substitute legal representative; how the witness is selected; that the consent discussion with a doctor, nurse or pharmacist of the trial team, adequate decision time and the right to ask questions are preserved; how information read aloud or given by another method is documented; that the witness signs and dates the consent document, the participant or representative signs where able and the person conducting the interview signs and dates; and that the participant or representative receives a copy.
fields.v121: Required in Estonia when emergency enrolment is used: in the answer language, explain each Article 35 condition for the specific emergency condition and therapeutic window; the procedure for identifying and documenting the emergency, the reason prior consent is impossible, the check for an available legal representative within the therapeutic window and for known prior objections, and the protective measures before consent; that consent to continue is sought without undue delay from the legal representative (minors and incapacitated participants) or from the participant or legal representative, whichever is available first; that a later refusal or withdrawal is respected and what happens to treatment, follow-up and data already collected; and what is documented (time of intervention, why prior consent was impossible, when the participant or representative was informed, when the ongoing-consent decision was recorded). Estonia publishes no separate national emergency form.

fields.v125: Required in Estonia: identify the study centre by its legal name; a commonly used English name may be added in parentheses. Site facts come from the site.
fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Estonia: the form is signed by a person legally authorised by the study centre (manual signature on paper or digital signature). The site completes and signs; the assistant leaves the block empty. If the original is an Estonian .asice digital-signature container, upload a PDF in CTIS and retain the .asice original at the study centre.

fields.f04: Estonia: monetary compensation is allowed only for competent participants, for inconvenience and burdensome procedures, when the need and amount are justified in the application and approved by the Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products; it reflects time and contribution (for healthy volunteers the time element is based on the minimum wage in force in Estonia in the year the trial was initiated), is not payment for risk and does not depend on the risk level. Minors and their representatives, incapacitated participants and their representatives, pregnant women and breastfeeding women receive only reimbursement of direct costs.
fields.f06: Estonia: no completion bonus, no payment made conditional on completing the trial and no large share held back to encourage continued participation. Amounts and conditions only from the sponsor's sources.

fields.f03: Required in Estonia: describe for each sample type what is collected, whether it is pseudonymised or anonymised, how it is transported, where it is stored, how long it is stored in years and when it will be destroyed; state whether samples may leave Estonia or the EEA and whether genetic analysis is involved.

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json. No country-specific form: Estonia uses the EC forms for every shared document.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section, for one population and language.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor, site). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates_missing.name: Subject information and informed consent form - capable adult participants
participant_templates_missing.role: default adult information and consent; also the adult form for re-consent at adulthood and after regained capacity
participant_templates_missing.basis: Estonia national SIS/ICF template (Ravimiamet, approved by the Ethics Committee; not supplied) or the EC Part II templates

participant_templates_missing.name: Subject information and informed consent form - healthy volunteers
participant_templates_missing.role: information and consent for healthy volunteers
participant_templates_missing.basis: Estonia national SIS/ICF template adapted to the healthy-volunteer protocol

participant_templates_missing.name: Information and informed consent form - legal representative of a minor
participant_templates_missing.role: full information and legal consent of the legally designated representative of a minor

participant_templates_missing.name: Information and consent form - minors aged 7 to 17
participant_templates_missing.role: age- and maturity-adapted information and the minor's own consent, required in addition to the legal representative's consent (Medicinal Products Act)

participant_templates_missing.name: Information sheet - children under 7
participant_templates_missing.role: simple information for a young child who can understand it; the legal representative gives the formal consent

participant_templates_missing.name: Information and informed consent form - legal representative of an incapacitated adult
participant_templates_missing.role: representative consent taking the participant's presumed intent into account; also the emergency representative version

participant_templates_missing.name: Simplified participant information - adult unable to consent
participant_templates_missing.role: information adapted to the participant's capacity; participant involvement and dissent

participant_templates_missing.name: Participant information and consent to continue - emergency enrolment
participant_templates_missing.role: information and consent sought without undue delay after an Article 35 emergency intervention

participant_templates_missing.name: Impartial witness attestation and consent record
participant_templates_missing.role: witnessed consent when the participant or legal representative cannot write (Article 29) or cannot read (ICH E6(R3))

participant_templates_missing.name: Information and consent - pregnancy follow-up of a participant
participant_templates_missing.role: additional pregnancy, outcome and infant information collected from a pregnant participant

participant_templates_missing.name: Information and consent or authorisation - pregnant partner of a participant
participant_templates_missing.role: partner-facing document for collecting the partner's pregnancy and outcome data

participant_templates_missing.name: Optional future use of data and samples - information and consent choices
participant_templates_missing.role: separate consent for use of pseudonymised health data or biological samples outside the main protocol

participant_templates_missing_note: No Estonian participant templates were supplied in CTIS_EE, and the Estonia national SIS/ICF template recommended by the guides was not supplied either. Until a set is supplied (to be split into templates/participant as *_EE_et.json), draft each participant document from the Estonia guides (drafting_rules, population_sets, checklists/participant-documents.json) with styles/base.md and countries/EE/styling.md, or adapt it from its reference-package counterpart (based_on) (DECISIONS.md D15).

population_sets.basis: Estonia patient information and consent guide; national SIS/ICF template recommended as baseline (not supplied).
population_sets.note: Default adult information and consent form in Estonian. Also the adult form for re-consent when a minor reaches adulthood or an incapacitated participant regains capacity.

Dedicated document when the trial has both patient and healthy cohorts, or when procedures, risk-benefit explanation, payment structure or screening differ materially. Not a patient form with the disease name removed. Risk wording not softened. Compensation only as approved by the Ethics Committee, based on time and contribution (minimum wage in the year the trial was initiated).

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_minors 7-17_<population>_EE_et
documents.condition: participants aged 7 to 17 are enrolled; split into age-adapted versions when the range is wide (DECISIONS.md D7)

documents.title: L1_SIS_children under 7_<population>_EE_et
documents.condition: children under 7 who can understand simple information (DECISIONS.md D8)

population_sets.note: Legal-representative information and consent always. For ages 7 to 17 the minor's own consent is required in addition to the representative's (Medicinal Products Act): separate child or adolescent documents plus the representative form, or a coordinated form that makes each person's decision and signature clear (DECISIONS.md D7). Below 7 the representative consents; a young-child information sheet where the child can understand. Re-consent with EE-PT-main (or EE-PT-healthy) when a participant reaches adulthood. No participation compensation beyond direct costs.

Article 31 conditions. Representative consent takes the participant's presumed intent into account; a decision that clearly harms the participant's interests cannot be relied on. Participant informed to a reasonable extent with information adapted to capacity; acknowledgement or signature only where it reflects the participant's role. Re-consent with EE-PT-main when capacity is regained. No participation compensation beyond direct costs.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency legal representative_<population>_EE_et
documents.condition: where a legal representative is consulted

population_sets.note: Article 35 only, every condition shown. Information and consent to continue sought without undue delay; separate what has already happened from what happens next. No national emergency form: adapt the standard Estonian documents. Layer the minor or incapacity rules when relevant.

No separate national witness form: the standard Estonian form with a witness attestation and signature block (DECISIONS.md D12). Witness independent, not a legal decision-maker; participant or representative signs where able; person conducting the interview signs and dates.

What pregnancy, outcome and infant information is collected and for how long; safety follow-up distinguished from continued dosing. Only direct-cost reimbursement for pregnant or breastfeeding participants. No national template.

Separate document addressed to the partner; the participant's main form is not the partner's consent. Estonian version when used with an Estonian-speaking partner, plus any other language actually intended. No promise of sponsor access to the national Health Information System.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_future use_EE_et
documents.condition: separate document, or separate consent choices inside the main form (DECISIONS.md D10)

population_sets.note: Ravimiamet recommends separate consents in the information form for trial participation and for use of pseudonymised health data or biological samples. Refusing optional future use does not prevent participation in the main trial. Representative versions for minors or incapacitated participants.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which documents a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents, in Estonian and in every other participant language intended for use. Every template is "missing": none was supplied.

population_rules.authority: State Agency of Medicines (Ravimiamet) and the Ethics Committee for Medicinal Products (Part II requirements, compensation and consent Q&A, updated 25 May 2026); Estonia Medicinal Products Act, sections 99³ and 99⁵; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35; ICH E6(R3); as recorded in the Estonia guides reviewed 23 September 2026.
population_rules.template_status: No Estonian participant templates were supplied: participant_templates is empty and every template id below refers to participant_templates_missing ("template": "missing" in population_sets).

language_sets.et: missing: every participant document is planned in Estonian.
language_sets.other: Each other language intended for use with participants (for example Russian or English) is an extra version of the same document, titled _EE_<lang> (DECISIONS.md D2). The guides do not mention Russian.

age_bands.basis: Medicinal Products Act section 99⁵: for a person aged 7 to 17 consent from the minor as well as the legal representative, taking the minor's intent into account. Statutory band; age-adapted versions inside it are drafting choices (DECISIONS.md D7).
No national co-consent rule below 7; a young-child information sheet may be appropriate when the child can understand simple information (DECISIONS.md D8).

minors.band_rule: 7 to 17 is the statutory co-consent band. Every age band in the protocol needs a matching information document; adapt to age and mental maturity, never shorten the adult form mechanically. Do not design the 7 to 17 document so that only the representative decides and the minor merely acknowledges receiving information.
minors.representatives: The legally designated representative consents. The number of representative signatures depends on who is legally authorised in the specific case; no two-parent rule without a verified legal basis (DECISIONS.md D9).
minors.assent_dissent: An explicit wish of a minor capable of forming an opinion to refuse or withdraw is respected (Article 32). The representative's consent does not remove the requirement to involve the minor.
minors.reconsent_at_adulthood: EE-PT-main or EE-PT-healthy when the participant reaches legal adulthood and ongoing participation still requires consent; the protocol and consent plan say when and how.
minors.payment: Minors and their representatives receive no compensation for participation, only reimbursement of direct costs.

adults_without_capacity.note: Only when the participant cannot give valid consent and Article 31 permits inclusion. Representative consent takes presumed intent into account; a decision that clearly harms the participant's interests cannot be relied on. Diagnosis, disability or age alone is not proof of incapacity. Re-consent with EE-PT-main when capacity is regained; plan for fluctuating capacity. Only reimbursement of direct costs for participant and representative.

emergency.note: Article 35 only. Consent to continue without undue delay from the representative (minors, incapacitated participants) or from the participant or representative, whichever is available first. No national emergency form.

impartial_witness.note: When the participant or representative cannot write (Article 29) or, under ICH E6(R3), cannot read. Not for disability or limited literacy alone when a valid process is possible without it. A witness cannot cure an otherwise invalid pathway; minor and capacity rules still apply.

pregnancy.participant: EE-PT-pregnancy when the protocol requires pregnancy follow-up of an enrolled participant beyond the main form
pregnancy.partner: EE-PT-pregnant-partner whenever identifiable health information about a participant's pregnant partner is collected
pregnancy.payment: Pregnant and breastfeeding participants receive only reimbursement of direct costs; do not extend this rule to a non-participant partner without assessing the legal and ethics position.

secondary_use.note: Separate consent choices for trial participation and for use of pseudonymised health data or biological samples (Ravimiamet). No bundled 'I agree to everything' signature. Ethical consent is not automatically the GDPR legal basis.

compensation.all_participants: Unavoidable expenses directly caused by trial participation are reimbursed; the application justifies them and the ICF explains the principles. Compensation information is in the ICF, never in recruitment material.
compensation.competent_adults: Justified compensation for inconvenience and burdensome procedures allowed when justified in the application and approved by the Ethics Committee; reflects time and contribution (healthy volunteers: time based on the Estonian minimum wage in the year the trial was initiated); not payment for risk; no completion bonus or held-back share.
compensation.restricted: Minors and their representatives, incapacitated participants and their representatives, pregnant women and breastfeeding women: only reimbursement of direct costs.

separate_document_rules: The default adult form is not enough for every population: healthy volunteers, minors, incapacitated adults, emergency enrolment, impartial witness, pregnancy follow-up and secondary use need additional consent logic, not a copy of the adult form (Estonia hub and patient information guide).
Patients and healthy volunteers in one trial: a dedicated healthy-volunteer document.
Minors aged 7 to 17: the minor's own consent and the representative's consent, each decision and signature clear.
The pregnant partner receives her own document; the participant's main form is not her consent.
Optional future use of data or samples is a separate choice from main-trial participation.
Re-consent with the adult form when a minor reaches adulthood or an incapacitated participant regains capacity.

drafting_rules: Participant documents are in plain Estonian suitable for the target population; every other language intended for use is provided as a complete version of the same document. Headings explain the decision being made; abbreviations defined; risks not hidden in dense paragraphs.
Use the term 'participant' (Estonian 'uuringus osaleja'), not 'patient', throughout participant materials (Ethics Committee guidance).

Every participant-facing item carries the EU CT number, together with a clear version number, date, consistent trial identifier, sponsor name, site name where site-specific and the correct language label.

Start from the Estonia national SIS/ICF template (Ravimiamet, approved by the Ethics Committee) or the EC Part II templates, and adapt to the actual intervention, procedures, population, risks, data flows, samples, reimbursement and optional research. The template is a baseline, not a substitute for protocol-specific content.

Cover: purpose and why the person is invited; investigational treatment, comparator and randomisation; visits, tests, procedures, samples and participant responsibilities; foreseeable risks, burdens and inconveniences; expected benefits, including when no direct benefit is expected; alternatives; pregnancy, contraception and reproductive precautions; samples; personal and health data; insurance and trial-related injury; reimbursement and approved compensation; voluntariness, withdrawal and what happens after withdrawal; contacts for study questions, safety concerns and participant rights; optional future research as a separate decision.

Every statement matches the current protocol and other trial documents (visit counts, time commitments, treatment periods, follow-up, blood volumes, imaging, biopsies, washouts, prohibited medicines, pregnancy testing); no procedure, benefit or risk statement the sources do not support. Participants receive only information relevant to the pathway they may enter.

Consent: before consent the participant or legal representative speaks with a trial-team member who is a doctor, nurse or pharmacist with thorough knowledge of the trial and the IMP; adequate time to decide; written, dated and signed by the participant or representative and by the person conducting the interview; a digital signature valid under Estonian law is allowed; the participant receives a copy.

Remote consent only by video call with electronic identification, with clear identification, normal questioning, time to decide and the same rights as face to face, a legally accepted signature, and prior justification and approval by the Ethics Committee.

Data protection explained in detail and as the actual data flow: data categories, who collects and controls, who may access coded source data, pseudonymisation, transfers outside Estonia or the EEA, retention, monitoring and audit access, withdrawal consequences, optional future research, rights and contacts. Trial consent is not presented as the GDPR legal basis for all processing.

Separate consent choices for trial participation and for use of pseudonymised health data or biological samples; the main-trial consent is not conditioned on optional research, genetics, sample storage or data use unless the protocol and law genuinely require it.

Source-data access wording is realistic: sponsor representatives do not automatically gain direct access to Estonia's national Health Information System; trial-site systems determine what access can be provided.

Samples: for each sample type state what is collected, purpose, coding status, transport, storage location, retention in years, destruction, genetic analysis, whether future use is optional and whether samples may leave Estonia or the EEA; consistent with S1.

Compensation and reimbursement as in population_rules.compensation: reimbursement principles in the ICF; no completion bonus or deferred large share; restricted groups receive only direct-cost reimbursement.
Withdrawal wording is realistic: distinguish stopping new optional use, retention required for safety, reliability or legal obligations, data already used and irreversibly anonymised material.
Blank documents in CTIS: no pre-signed participant signature, no participant personal data, no tracked changes or drafting comments; signature blocks match the actual consent pathway.

Participant templates were not supplied; where a reference document or a later template is used, its instructions ([square-bracket] notes, italic notes, '...........' gaps) and Part II form instructions (yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels) are drafting instructions; none may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.estonia_note: Use the CTCG pattern; the Estonia guides use descriptive names and give no national naming instruction beyond keeping document naming and language version clear so assessors can match materials. _EE_et on participant-facing documents and the K1 procedure (_EE_<lang> for other participant languages), _EE on O1, P1, P2, R1 and S1. P2 (budget information) and the invoice details carry proposed titles (DECISIONS.md D5, D6). Uploaded filenames avoid ( ) / , . ; | [ ].

sources_note: All Estonia guides reviewed 23 September 2026, read 27 November 2026 (11 pages). '#n' after EE-PII-CHECKLIST is the item number on that page. The RAVIMIAMET-* and MPA entries are the official sources the guides cite; they were not read separately. Supplied: CTIS_EE Part II DOCX set and the Estonian variable sheet (compared with the shared forms); no participant templates.
